name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
character: The 760-acre campus features expansive lawns, shrub beds, historic quadrangles, neoclassical architecture, and notable trees such as the Davie Poplar.

landmarks.name: Old Well
landmarks.quote: A symbol of the university is the Old Well, a small neoclassical rotunda
landmarks.look: Small white neoclassical rotunda with columns on a grassy quad.

landmarks.name: McCorkle Place
landmarks.quote: This is named McCorkle Place after Samuel Eusebius McCorkle
landmarks.look: Grassy quadrangle with trees, flanked by historic buildings.

landmarks.name: Polk Place
landmarks.quote: A second quadrangle, Polk Place, was built in the 1920s
landmarks.look: Open grassy quadrangle bordered by academic buildings.

landmarks.name: Morehead–Patterson bell tower
landmarks.quote: The Morehead–Patterson bell tower, south of the Wilson Library
landmarks.look: Tall bell tower surrounded by a hedge and landscaped grounds.

landmarks.name: Wilson Library
landmarks.quote: The Wilson Library is at the south end of Polk Place.
landmarks.look: Large, stately library building at the end of a quad.

landmarks.name: Kenan Memorial Stadium
landmarks.quote: The middle part of the campus includes Fetzer Field and Woollen Gymnasium along with the Student Recreation Center, Kenan Memorial Stadium

landmarks.name: Playmakers Theatre
landmarks.quote: The historic Playmakers Theatre is located on Cameron Avenue
